subject: SWX Systems: API versioning, entitlement fallback & onboard playbook
messages:
From: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@swxsystems.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Cc: Maya Lin <maya.lin@swxsystems.com>
Date: 2026-11-01 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: SWX integration asks + API versioning question

Aditya —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. SWX is excited to pursue a marketplace listing and a joint integration where our SI customers can call Redwood models through our control plane. Before we kick engineering, a couple of gotchas from our side: 

1) API versioning: our gateway enforces a strict API contract. We need a recommended compatibility strategy if Redwood makes model or API changes that could break calls (we prefer out-of-band feature flags or explicit version headers).

2) Billing/entitlement fallback: some enterprise customers want to route inference through our account for consolidated billing, but require a fallback to Redwood-hosted billing if outages occur. Is there an existing supported pattern (token exchange, delegated billing) and recommended audit logging?

I've attached a short integration spec and a draft MAP (mutual action plan). Can your team review and confirm what you need from SWX to scope this work?

Thanks,
Ethan
Ethan Cole
Head of Integrations, SWX Systems
Mobile: +1 415-555-0119

Attachments: swx_integration_spec_v1.pdf, swx_mutual_action_plan.xlsx
From: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
To: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@swxsystems.com>, Maya Lin <maya.lin@swxsystems.com>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.ai, camila_reyes@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-01 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SWX integration asks + API versioning question

Ethan —

Appreciate the clear spec and MAP. Looping in product (Priyom), engineering (Rishi via separate note), solutions (Camila) and partnerships (Laura/Ben) to align on scoping and go/no-go items. Quick answers up-front:

- API versioning: we support a header-based model-version header and stable API paths. For compatibility we recommend: pinning model_version in the MAP, a semantic model version header (x-redwood-model-version), and a canary rollout window for model upgrades. We can provide an SDK shim that translates older calls for ~90 days during upgrades.

- Billing & fallback: Redwood supports delegated-billing via a scoped token exchange (customer grants SWX a limited token scope for a given workspace). For automatic fallback we can implement a signed fallback policy (signed JWT) that allows SWX to route to Redwood-hosted billing when your gateway reports degraded health. We'll need audit hooks (request id + customer id) — we can provide a sample log schema.

Priyom / Camila / Laura: can you review the attached MAP and flag gaps (risk, legal, timeline)? Ethan: we propose a two-week technical spike to validate the token-exchange flow and fallback logging. Is 11/15–11/28 workable?

—Aditya
Aditya Rao
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference

From: priyom_das@redwood.ai
To: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@swxsystems.com>, camila_reyes@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-02 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SWX integration asks + API versioning question

Ethan / all —

Reviewed the MAP and spec. High-level product asks and constraints from Redwood side: 

1) Spike goals (2 weeks): token-exchange POC, fallback routing demo (switch to hosted billing), and an audit log prototype.

2) Production requirements: we will need (a) an explicit model_version header on requests, (b) a signed fallback policy endpoint returned to SWX during token issuance, (c) per-request tracing id to correlate logs across both platforms.

3) SLOs and fallbacks: we can offer an SLA-backed dedicated path for anchor customers, but for initial marketplace listing we'll require a soft-rollback policy: if latency > 1.5x or error_rate > 2% for 3m, SWX must automatically surface the fallback token to route to Redwood-hosted endpoints. We should agree on telemetry thresholds and a monitoring handoff.

4) Timeline asks: to avoid blocking their marketplace listing, we recommend landing the token exchange and MAP sign-off by end of November. Legal redlines will likely add a week.

Action items assigned in MAP (see attachment):
- Priyom: finalize SDK shim contract and provide sample request/response (due 11/10)
- Rishi: outline infra changes for signed fallback policy and trace schema (due 11/08)
- Camila: coordinate SWX SI kickoff and define success metrics (due 11/05)
- Monica: onboarding checklist for entitlement flows and billing mapping (due 11/12)

I will own the technical acceptance criteria.

-Priyom
Principal Product Manager, Redwood Inference

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: priyom_das@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai, Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@swxsystems.com>, camila_reyes@redwood.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-03 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SWX integration asks + API versioning question

Ethan / Team —

Tech digest for the spike and production plan below. TL;DR: feasible with two small infra pieces and an SDK shim.

1) Token exchange: we will implement a short-lived delegated token issuance endpoint. Flow: SWX calls /oauth/delegate with a customer-scoped assertion -> Redwood returns a scoped token + signed fallback_policy_jwt (contains policy_id, expiry, and allowed_models). We'll expose an endpoint for policy verification. Security: HMAC + rotating keys stored in KMS.

2) Fallback routing: implement a proxy-level healthcheck on SWX side that flips to inbound-hosted when SWX reports degraded service — the signed fallback_policy_jwt will enable Redwood to accept requests and bill under SWX account for the duration. We will require a signed request-id header to avoid replay.

3) API versioning: we will require x-redwood-model-version header. For breaking model changes we will publish a deprecation window in our model catalog and provide the shim. Shim complexity: medium; estimate 2 engineer-weeks to build and 1 week for integration tests.

4) Audit logs: proposed log schema (CSV rows): timestamp, request_id, customer_id, swx_account_id, model_version, billing_path, latency_ms, status_code. We'll publish a Kibana dashboard for initial visibility.

Risks: legal/entitlement mapping (billing under SWX) needs contract clarity; edge-case with large-batched streaming calls may need special treatment.

I'll spin up a repo and post the Spike README by EOD 11/03.

—Rishi
Staff Software Engineer, Serving Runtime

From: Maya Lin <maya.lin@swxsystems.com>
To: priyom_das@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, camila_reyes@redwood.ai

Date: 2026-11-03 15:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SWX integration asks + API versioning question

Thanks — this is very helpful. A couple of clarifying notes from SWX infra/legal: 

- Timeline: 11/15–11/28 spike window is OK; we also need a risk matrix in the MAP for customers who cannot accept delegated billing (finance/regulatory constraints).

- Security: SWX Legal requested proof that the fallback_policy_jwt cannot be misused to retroactively bill unrelated tenants. Can you add token scoping to the spec (aud, sub, allowed_customer_ids)?

- Marketplace listing: we want a checklist of gating items for the partner listing (docs, SSO, entitlements mapping, billing flow). Can Redwood provide a preflight checklist?

We'll review the attached MAP and redlines will come back by EOD 11/05.

Regards,
Maya Lin
Director, Platform Partnerships, SWX Systems

Attachments referenced: redlines_swx_msa.docx
From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: Maya Lin <maya.lin@swxsystems.com>, Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@swxsystems.com>, aditya_rao@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, camila_reyes@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-04 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SWX integration asks + API versioning question

Maya / Ethan —

Thanks for the feedback and the MSA redlines in advance. Quick responses and next steps from Redwood ops/legal: 

- Token scoping: agreed — fallback_policy_jwt will include aud, sub, allowed_customer_ids, policy_id, issued_at and expiry. Legal will prepare a short appendix describing how billing scoping works so SWX can show it to their finance/regulatory teams.

- Marketplace preflight checklist: attached below (we also uploaded to the Drive link). Items included: docs (integration spec), SSO config guide, entitlement matrix sample, signed fallback policy spec, MAP sign-off, security questionnaire (SOC2 evidence), and a basic performance test report.

- Timeline: assuming spike runs 11/15–11/28 and legal redlines returned by 11/05, target MVP listing 12/10 with a limited set of anchor customers. If SWX needs an accelerated listing we can prioritize the listing checklist items and ship a gated listing with a ‘beta’ label.

Action-owner recap:
- Rishi: start Spike repo + README (in progress)
- Priyom: SDK shim contract (due 11/10)
- Camila: set SI kickoff and engineer calendar invites (due 11/05)
- Monica: onboarding checklist and billing mapping doc (due 11/12)
- Laura: coordinate legal appendix and listing checklist (due 11/06)

We'll sync in a 30-minute cross-functional call on 11/05 10:00 AM PT to walk the MAP and gating list — invite to follow.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
